vocab_words.example: The new printer is compatible with most devices.
Customer records are stored in a secure database.
The company went from near bankruptcy to a high level of profitability
Please review the agenda before tomorrow's meeting.
All correspondence with clients must be archived.
The manager sent a memorandum about the new dress code.
We need to order more stationery for the office.
The filing system was reorganized last month.
Her itinerary includes three cities in five days.

items.question: The document must be reviewed carefully ___ submitting it.
items.explanation: Ngữ cảnh cần trước khi nộp thì phải xem lại tài liệu, dùng "before".

items.question: This is one of the ___ effective marketing strategies we have used.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc so sánh nhất "one of the most + adj".

items.question: It is essential that all staff ___ the new safety guidelines.
items.explanation: Câu giả định sau "it is essential that" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu.

items.question: The HR department is responsible for ___ new employees.
items.explanation: Sau giới từ "for" cần V-ing (danh động từ).

items.question: The manager, along with two assistants, ___ attending the conference.
items.explanation: Cụm "along with..." không ảnh hưởng tới động từ, chia theo chủ ngữ chính số ít "the manager".

items.question: The new policy will take effect ___ the beginning of next month.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "at the beginning of" dùng giới từ "at".

items.question: The report should be submitted ___ the end of the fiscal year.
items.explanation: Ngữ cảnh cần nộp trước một mốc thời gian, dùng "before".

items.question: Neither the manager nor the employees ___ aware of the schedule change.
items.explanation: Với cấu trúc "neither...nor", động từ chia theo chủ ngữ gần nhất (employees - số nhiều).

items.question: The staff were given clear instructions ___ how to use the new system.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "instructions on how to...".

items.question: The invoice should be paid ___ 30 days of receipt.
items.explanation: "Within + khoảng thời gian" nghĩa là trong vòng bao lâu.
